column1: # Copyright (c) 2024-2026 Michael Laurence Curzi and 36N9 Genetics, LLC
# The concept registry: every idea more than one app needs has ONE owner,
# a block or an app (apps are blocks too, zxapp.h C1), and every other app
# reaches it with "use <owner> <major>", never by writing it again.
# tools/apps/concepts.py --check fails when a manifest provides a name a
# concept here owns, or when two manifests provide the same name and it is
# neither a concept nor a local word (last section).

column2: owner (manifest.entry, or zxvd:<method> for a daemon method)
column4: meaning
share of a capacity in use, in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * (total - left) / total); refused when total is 0 or left is more than total
each size's share of the sum of the total vector, in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * size / sum of total), a zero sum counted as 1
whole days in a count of seconds: floor(seconds / 86400)
hours past the last whole day: floor(seconds mod 86400 / 3600)
the greatest common divisor of two integers, never negative
each agent's share of a swarm cycle's tokens
the busiest agent in a swarm cycle
a swarm share and intensity inside the owner's limits
net present value of integer cash flows at a rational rate
a Bayesian update in integers
whether a seller's minimum and a buyer's maximum overlap

a 16-bit sample scaled by a level in hundredths of a percent (10000 is unity): floor(sample * level / 10000), the floor toward minus infinity, then held inside -32768..32767 (saturating, never wrapped); level is one value for the whole buffer; a sample outside 16 bits or a level outside 0..1000000 is refused as -32769

how long a count of samples of one channel lasts at a rate in hertz, in milliseconds: samples * 1000 / rate as an exact reduced rational, never rounded; a rate of 0 is refused, and so is a product that does not fit int64
where a reading falls against a range lo..hi, both ends inside: -1 below lo, 0 inside, 1 above hi; refused when lo is above hi (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)
progress toward a goal in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * done / goal), past 10000 when the goal is beaten; a goal of 0 refused, done or goal negative or past 999999999 held (Sutra's 9(9))

a minute of the day (0..1439) inside a daily window: opens <= now < closes; opens after closes crosses midnight (now >= opens or now < closes); opens equal to closes is the whole day; a minute outside 0..1439 is in no window (zxv_screen.c keeps the same rule for an app's hours)

whether a notice goes through a quiet time: a Watchfire emergency (emergency > 0) always, whatever else is said; otherwise when not quiet (quiet < 1), the sender is allowed (allowed > 0), or the same caller called before within 180 seconds (0 <= gap <= 180; gap -1: no earlier call)

one link of a chain of integer indexes: an entry is linked when its prev index equals the index of the entry before it (last; 0 for the first) and its own index is past last; a chain is intact when every entry is linked; an index negative or past 18 digits is held (Sutra's 9(18) refuses, KRON answers)
how many entries of a vector of kinds equal one kind (want, one value for the whole vector), exact; two wants are held (Trebago refuses, KRON sums them)
an audit record entry fits ^ZXWIT: seq and prev at most 18 digits, kind 1 digit, stamp (ms since 1970) at most 15 digits, sign aside

whole minutes a store of energy lasts at a steady draw: floor(60 * charge / draw), charge in milliwatt-hours and draw in milliwatts (any unit-hour over the same unit); refused when draw is 0 or negative, charge is negative, or either passes 999999999 (Sutra's 9(9))

an account's balance after a movement, in integer minor units of its currency (cents for USD): before + moved, one account per row; before, moved and the result must each fit 18 digits either way (-999999999999999999..999999999999999999, Sutra's s9(18)), else refused, never rounded or wrapped (Trebago answers to 64 bits, so past 18 digits the answer is held)

whether a transfer may be posted: amount 1..9007199254740991 minor units (2^53 - 1, libzxv ZXV_AMOUNT_MAX), after (the paying holder balance minus the amount) and room (the owner's per-day cap minus what was spent today minus the amount) each 0..999999999999999999, and gap (what leaves one account minus what enters the other) exactly 0; an issuer account has no floor and its money coming in is not spending, so its after and room are taken as 0; the post still waits for the owner's confirmation
what is held in one currency: the exact sum of account balances in minor units, added from the first; refused when a partial sum passes 64 bits, never rounded or wrapped

how many whole cells of a size fit across a span of pixels (a terminal's columns or rows, any character or tile grid): floor(pixels / cell), a part cell never counted; the domain is pixels 0..65535 and cell 1..256, anything outside it refused as -1 (C++ refuses, KRON answers: held)

whether an app may use a capability: asked (its manifest needs it) AND granted (the owner said yes) AND not revoked, each a flag 0 or 1; a flag that is no flag (not 0 or 1) is never read as yes (Eve refuses it, KRON reads above 0 as yes: held)
the same rule as capability_use_allowed as a number to count with: 1 when asked AND granted AND not revoked, else 0; a flag that is no flag is refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

how many apps hold one capability: the exact sum of one flag per app (1 may use it, 0 not); a flag that is no flag makes the count held (KRON holds each flag inside 0..1, Trebago sums them as they are)

whether a seat of one role may add, remove or change the lock of a seat (roles 1 owner, 2 person, 3 guest; own 1 when it is the actor's own seat, else 0): target is 1 or 2, own is 0 or 1, and role is 1 (an owner, any lock) or role is 2 with own 1 (a person, their own); a guest never has a lock, so a target of 3 and a role of 3 are always refused; a role or flag past 9 or negative is held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

whether the login is skipped: exactly one seat (seats = 1), its lock none (lock = 0) and auto-enter on (auto = 1); a flag that is neither 0 nor 1 is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any positive auto as on and any lock below 1 as none)
whether a passphrase's length in bytes of UTF-8 is allowed: 12 <= length <= 1024
the columns of a near-square grid for n items, n 0..64: the least c with c * c >= n (0 for none); n outside 0..64 refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)
the rows of that grid: n over its columns (grid_columns), rounded up (0 for none); n outside 0..64 refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)
one cell along a side split evenly: floor(span / parts) pixels, span 0..16384, parts 1..64; parts 0 refused by both languages, anything else outside refused by C++ while KRON answers (held)
how many pixels of a segment pos..pos+size-1 lie on a side 0..span-1: max(0, min(pos + size, span) - max(pos, 0)); pos -99999..99999, size and span 0..99999 (Sutra's pictures), anything else held
a window inside its limits: width 160..16384 and height 100..16384 pixels, and 32..16384 pixels of it shown across and down, each worked out by segment_on_screen

one label of a name fits: the label is 1..63 bytes, the name (a trailing dot aside) 1..253 bytes and no shorter than the label, and no byte is outside a-z A-Z 0-9 '-' or a '-' starts or ends the label (bad = 0); Eve holds the ranges, KRON also the label within its name (a label longer than its name is held)

why one label of a name does not fit, the first that applies: 1 the label is empty or past 63 bytes, 2 the name is past 253 bytes or shorter than its label, 3 a byte not allowed where it stands, 0 none; a negative count is refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

the class of an IPv4 address a.b.c.d (RFC 6890): 0 public, 1 this network 0/8, 2 loopback 127/8, 3 private 10/8 172.16/12 192.168/16, 4 link-local 169.254/16, 5 shared 100.64/10, 6 multicast 224/4, 7 reserved 240/4, 8 the broadcast 255.255.255.255; an octet outside 0..255 is refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)
seconds left before an answer stored at `stored` with a time to live of `ttl` lapses at `now`: stored + ttl - now, never below 0 (0 is lapsed); a sum past int64 is refused

how far a value has come toward a threshold, in hundredths of a percent, floored and held at 10000 (the threshold met): min(10000, floor(10000 * have / need)); have 0..999999999 and need 1..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)); a need of 0, a negative or a value past 9(9) is held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers)

whether every input is at or above its threshold, each given as its margin (have - need): credibility and bond margins 0..999999999999999999, the uptime margin 0..10000 basis points (an uptime past 10000 bps is no measurement); a margin past its range is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as met)

the same rule as thresholds_met as a number to count with: 1 when every margin is inside its range, else 0; a margin past its range is held (Trebago refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as met)

when a task that runs every `period` minutes (1..1440) from minute `start` of the day (0..1439) next runs at minute `now` (0..1439): the first start + k * period (k >= 0) at or after now, in minutes from today's midnight; when that is past 1439, tomorrow's first run, start + 1440; anything outside the domain refused (C++ traps, Sutra and KRON answer: held; a period of 0 refused by all)

whether a run of `cost` tokens fits the owner's budget: cost 0..999999999 and left (the owner's cap minus what was spent today minus the cost) 0..999999999; a value past nine digits is no budget the owner set (Eve refuses it, KRON reads only the floors: held); the run still waits for the owner's approval

whether row `row` (0.. in file order) of a dataset goes to the test set at a test share in hundredths of a percent: 1 when floor((row + 1) * share / 10000) is past floor(row * share / 10000), else 0 (training); every row lands in exactly one set and the first n rows hold exactly floor(n * share / 10000) test rows; a row outside 0..999999999 or a share outside 0..10000 refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

whether a row passes a filter over its columns: its label class equals lab (lab negative: any label), its source equals src (src negative: any source) and its date (YYYYMMDD) lies inside from..to, both ends included

whether what would leave the Hoard may go: it holds no personal row (personal = 0) or the owner consented to it (consent = 1); personal is a count 0..9999 (Sutra's 9(4)), a negative count or one past 9999 is held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers); consent other than 1 is no consent

whether a feature switch may change now: in the owner's session (owner = 1) and, when the change turns a regulated engine on (regulated = 1, enable = 1), with the owner's approval (approved = 1); turning off, or a plain engine on, needs only the owner's session; each a flag 0 or 1, a flag that is no flag never read as yes (Sutra reads 2..9 as no and refuses a negative, KRON reads above 0 as yes: held)

the owner's word for an action that needs it (a regulated engine turned on): the owner's own session (owner = 1) and the owner's approval (approved = 1), both exactly 1; anything else is no (Eve declares 1..1 for each, KRON reads above 0 as yes: a flag of 2 is held)

whether a font file's table directory may be read: 1..256 tables, the file at most 32 MiB (33554432 bytes) and every table inside it (offset + length <= size), one size for the whole directory; 1 accepted, 0 not; a negative offset, length or size is no measurement (Trebago refuses, KRON reads only the table ends: held)

how much of a set of code points (a script's letters) a font covers, in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * covered / total), never rounded up; total 1..1114112 (every Unicode code point) and covered 0..total, anything else refused, since nothing covers more of a set than it has (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the wait in seconds before each retry of `tries`, one answer per attempt k = 1..tries: min(most, base * 2^(k - 1)); tries 1..32, base 1..3600 and most 1..86400, anything else refused (BASIC refuses, KRON answers: held)

what a quantity of units comes to at a unit price, in integer minor units: quantity * price, exact; quantity and price each 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)), else held (Sutra refuses, C++ answers to 64 bits); a negative or a product past 64 bits refused by both

what one stage of a flow leaves unaccounted, one stage per row: before - after - loss (what came in, what went on, what was lost), exact in integer units (ml for a cellar); 0 conserves it; a result past 64 bits refused, never wrapped

a temperature probe count of sixteenths of a degree (raw -880..2000, -55 to 125 degrees) in tenths of a degree: floor(raw * 10 / 16), the floor toward minus infinity; a count outside the range refused (Forth refuses, KRON converts: held)

a package (zxpkg bundle) inside its limits: 1..64 files, 1..134217728 bytes in all, its largest file 1..2097152 bytes (one fab block of 2 MiB) and no bigger than the whole; Eve holds each range on its own, KRON also the largest file inside the whole (a largest file past the whole is held)
a package's record fits ^ZXSATCHEL: seq at most 9 digits, files 2, bytes 9, signed 1, stamp (ms since 1970) 15, sign aside

a parcel's charged weight in grams: max(mass, ceil(length * width * height / divisor)), sides in mm and the divisor in cubic mm per gram (5000 is 5000 cubic cm per kg); mass 0..999999999, each side 0..99999 and divisor 1..99999 (Sutra's pictures), the answer at most 999999999; a divisor of 0 or a negative refused by both, a side or answer past its picture held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers below 10^12)

the way round a parcel across its two shorter sides, 2 * (width + height) in mm (length plus girth adds the longest side); each side 0..99999 (Sutra's 9(5)), a negative or wider side held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

whether a parcel is inside a carrier's limits, each given as its margin (the limit minus the parcel's measure): mass 0..999999999 g, the longest side 0..99999 mm and length plus girth 0..499995 mm; a margin below 0 is over the limit, one past its range is no measurement and is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as inside)

the same rule as parcel_within_limits as a number to count with: 1 when every margin is inside its range, else 0; a margin past its range is held (Trebago refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as inside)

a shipment record fits ^ZXCARAVAN: ship 1..999999, carrier 1..999, mass and charged weight 0..999999999 g, status 0 drafted, 1 labelled, 2 handed over, 3 in transit, 4 delivered or 5 returned, stamp 0..9999999999 seconds since 1970; a status of 6 to 9 fits MYRA's digit only and is held (Eve refuses)

a saved password's strength, 0..100, from counts only (never its bytes): max(0, 3 * min(length, 20) + 10 * min(classes, 4) - 5 * repeats), length in bytes, classes of character (lower, upper, digit, symbol) and repeats (bytes equal to the one before); length and repeats 0..9999, classes 0..9 (Sutra's pictures), past them held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers); advice only

whole days left before something expires at `expires` seen at `now`, both seconds since 1970: floor((expires - now) / 86400), never below 0 (0 is due today or past); each 0..253402300799 (the last second of year 9999), else refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

a saved password or key phrase inside Lockbox's limits, each count against its own range: length 12..1024 bytes, classes of character 1..4 and repeats 0..1023 (the length band is threshold.phrase_ok's)

minutes left of a daily window at minute now: the window runs from minute opens up to minute closes (0..1439 each, opens included, closes not), crossing midnight when opens is after closes, the whole day when they are equal; inside it the minutes until it closes, 1..1440, outside it 0; a minute outside 0..1439 refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

whether an incoming call or message may ring now: the caller is a known contact (known = 1), not blocked (blocked = 0) and no quiet time is running (quiet = 0, the minutes of it left, minutes_of_window_left); a flag that is no flag is never read as yes (Eve refuses it, KRON reads known above 0 and quiet below 1 as yes: held)

a length in milliseconds as hours, minutes and seconds written h * 10000 + m * 100 + s (1:02:03 is 10203), whole seconds, the part second dropped, hours not wrapped at a day; ms 0..9999999999 (Sutra's 9(10)), a negative or longer length held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

a companion's or agent's growth stage from its generation: one step for each threshold reached, 1, 2, 5, 13 and 34 (every other Fibonacci number), so 0 newborn, 1 kit, 2 young, 3 grown, 4 elder, 5 sage; a generation is 0..4294967295 (swarm_dna.h D5 keeps it in 32 bits), anything else refused (Trebago answers -1, KRON counts the steps: held)
whether a generation has reached the grown stage of growth_stage (stage 3 or more): generation 5..4294967295; one past 32 bits is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any generation above 4 as grown)

a token amount in Zeckendorf form, as swarm_denom.h D1 and D3 hold it: bit k set when tier k, of face F(k+2) (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ...), holds a token, found greedily from the top, no two adjacent bits; amount 0..17167680177564 (below F(65), a 63-bit mask), anything else refused; FORTRAN 77 and its Lingua IR keep 32-bit integers and refuse past 3524577 (31 tiers) while BASIC answers: held

a byte 0..255 (a gene) as a strength in permille, rounded to nearest: floor((byte * 1000 + 127) / 255), as swarm_dna.c expresses a trait (D2); a value that is no byte is refused by the model before it asks (KRON alone answers any integer)
a memory of a talk with the companion fits ^ZXKITLING: seq at most 9 digits, stamp (ms since 1970) 15, emotion (swarm_emotion.h palette index) 1, intensity 1 and tokens 9, sign aside

in good standing for a grant: every reason flag 0, one flag per reason bit an appeal has not cleared (grants.eval's mask: uptime 1, dropped 2, routing 4, audit 8, fraud 16, volume 32, stake 64, invalid 128); a flag that is not 0 is never read as clear (Sutra refuses one below 0, Eve answers no: held)

a whole number of units split by weight, one recipient per row: floor(units * weight / W), W the sum of the weights, and the units left over one each to the largest remainders (units * weight mod W), a tie to the earlier recipient, so the parts sum to units exactly (grants.h G3); total is W and extra the row's leftover 1; units 0..999999999, each weight at least 0 and W 1..999999999, else refused; a total or an extra the weights do not give is held (Sutra answers with it, Trebago refuses it)

the member (0..members - 1) drawn at place step (0..members - 1) from a published seed: (seed + step * 1000003) mod members, 1000003 a prime above every member count, so the places reach every member once; seed 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)), members 1..999999, else refused (a longer seed: Sutra refuses, Trebago answers: held)

a pool's balance after each epoch, one epoch per row in order: opening + the running sum of (inflow - granted), exact in integer minor units; an amount below 0, a pool that would go below 0, or a sum past 64 bits refused

a display, sound and text setting inside its limits: brightness 0..100 and volume 0..100 (percent), text size 50..400 (percent of the normal size), each held to its own range with nothing relating them (Eve and KRON hold the same ranges)

one app's energy budget inside its limits: window 1..86400000 ms (0 is power.budget's clear, never a budget), spend and whole (the device's budget in the same window) 1..999999999 millijoules each, and spend <= whole; a spend past the whole is held (Eve holds each range alone, KRON also the spend inside the whole)

one coordinate of a cubic Bezier curve with control points pa, pb, pc, pd at t = step / steps, by de Casteljau in fixed point: with u = steps - step, three rounds of a * u + b * step, then the sum over steps^3 floored toward minus infinity; control points -1000000..1000000, steps 1..1024, step 0..steps, anything else refused as -1000001 (C++ refuses, KRON answers: held)

how many hatch lines a span takes at a spacing, lines at gap, 2 * gap, ... strictly inside it so neither edge is cut twice: floor((span - 1) / gap), 0 for a span of 0; span 0..9999999 and gap 1..9999999, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held; a gap of 0 refused by both)

the spacing that sets a count of hatch lines evenly across a span with both edges uncut: span / (lines + 1), an exact reduced rational, never rounded (line k at k * span / (lines + 1)); span 0..9999999 and lines 1..9999, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

one account's statement for a period, one account per row: closing = opening + credits - debits in integer minor units, as a camt.053 reconciles; credits and debits are the totals of one direction each, 0..999999999999999999, and opening and the closing fit 18 digits either way (Sutra's s9(18)); a total below 0 refused by both, past 18 digits held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers to 64 bits)

the tax in one band of a banded (marginal) table, one band per row: floor(max(0, min(income, hi) - lo) * rate / 10000), rate in hundredths of a percent (10000 all of it); income, lo and hi 0..99999999999999 minor units (Sutra's 9(14)), lo at most hi, rate 0..10000, else refused; an estimate is the exact sum over bands in order that never overlap; past 14 digits held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers); advice only, a person files

whether a period's statements and tax report may be rendered, saved and printed: the period is closed (closed = 1) and the books hold as ledger.check last answered (books = 1), each flag exactly 1; anything else is not allowed

the 0.08889% assurance fee on a sale or a settled payment (pay_assure.h F1): floor(amount * 8889 / 10000000), amount in integer minor units, never rounded up; amount 0..999999999999999 (Sutra's 9(15)) witnessed, 10^15..9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1, ZXV_AMOUNT_MAX) held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers), a negative amount or one past 2^53 - 1 refused by both; the fee is charged once, on the gross, and the buyer pays it on top of the price

whether a market offer (a want or a sell) is inside the owner's limits, the limits given as margins: price (one receipt's, minor units) and units each 1..999999999, priceroom (the owner's ceiling minus the price for a want, the price minus the owner's floor for a sell) and unitsroom (the owner's most units for one offer minus the units) each 0..999999999; a margin below 0 is past the limit; a value past 9 digits is held (Eve answers no, Sutra refuses)

the price per unit across offers: the sum of their prices over the sum of their units, an exact reduced rational, never rounded; each price 0 or more and each offer at least 1 unit, else refused; a sum past 64 bits refused, never wrapped

an offer's fixed business record, as a market files it: offer (its number) 0..9999, kind 1 share, 2 want, 3 sell, resource 1 compute, 2 storage, units and price 0..999999999999999999 (18 digits) and status 0 waiting for the owner, 1 sent, 2 refused by zxvd, 3 cancelled; a value past 18 digits refused outright (Sutra's s9(18))

the days in a month of the proleptic Gregorian calendar, 28..31: 31 for months 1, 3, 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 30 for 4, 6, 9, 11, February 29 in a year divisible by 4 except a century not divisible by 400, else 28; year 1..999999999999999999 and month 1..12, else refused; FORTRAN 77 and its Lingua IR keep 32-bit integers and refuse a year past 999999999, where BASIC answers (held)

the day of the week of a proleptic Gregorian date, 1 Monday..7 Sunday (ISO 8601), by Zeller's congruence; year 1..999999999999999999, month 1..12 and the day inside its month, else refused; FORTRAN 77 and its Lingua IR refuse a year past 999999999, where BASIC answers (held)

the next date of an event repeating every `every` days from day `start`, seen on day `today`, all days since 1970-01-01: the first start + k * every (k >= 0) on or after today; start and today 0..2932896 (9999-12-31), every 1..2932896, anything else refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held; an every of 0 refused by both)

whether two spans of time overlap, each from its start up to, not including, its finish (seconds since 1970), given as margins: aover (the first's finish minus the second's start) and bover (the second's finish minus the first's start) each 1..253402300799; a margin past that is no measurement and is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin above 0 as overlapping)

what a quantity of energy costs at a tariff: floor(mj * tariff / 3600000000), mj in millijoules and tariff in integer minor units per kWh (3600000000 mJ), never rounded up; mj 0..999999999999 (Sutra's 9(12), about 277 kWh) and tariff 0..999999 (9(6)), else held (Sutra refuses, C++ answers to 64 bits); a negative or a product past 64 bits refused by both; advice only, no bill

whether a budget is passed, given as the excess (what was used in a window minus its budget, in the budget's unit): passed when the excess is 1..999999999999999999, inside it at 0 or less; an excess past 18 digits is no measurement and is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any excess above 0 as passed)

each reading's rolling-window total, one reading per row in order: the exact sum of its own amount and the width - 1 before it (fewer at the start); every amount 0 or more and width 1..999999, else refused; a total past 64 bits refused, never wrapped

bytes left on a target after a move: avail (what the target may still write) - need (the bytes moved) - spare (the bytes kept free there), exact; below 0 the move is that many bytes short; each input 0..999999999999999 (Sutra's 9(15)), a negative one refused, one past it held (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers)
whether a move fits on its target: need + spare <= avail, each 0..999999999999999 bytes; one past that is held (Sutra refuses, KRON reads any size)

whether an item may move to another machine: kind 1 a file, 2 a space, 3 a setting move; 4 a regulated setting and 5 a key only with the owner's approval (approved = 1); kind 1..5, approved one digit 0..9; an approval past a digit is held (Sutra refuses, KRON reads any)

whether a command to a home device or appliance may run, as margins: above (setpoint - lo) and below (hi - setpoint) each 0..199998 (the setpoint inside the device's range -99999..99999), owed (guarded - approved: 1 for a lock, heater or oven without warren.approval_ok's yes) -1..0 and ai (an AI suggested it) exactly 0, since an AI's suggestion is held for the owner, never run; a margin past 199998 or a flag that is no flag is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as inside)

the same rule as device_command_allowed as a number to count with: 1 when allowed, else 0; a margin past 199998 either way, owed outside -1..1 or ai outside 0..1 is refused (Forth refuses, KRON answers: held)

one key's exact total over a vector of readings: the sum of the amounts (wh) whose key (device) equals want (one value for the whole vector), added from the first, 0 when none matches; a partial sum past 64 bits refused, never wrapped (Trebago adds from the first, KRON from the last: past 64 bits one way only is held)

safe to start normally from four check results: journal (zxvd's journal chain verified, journal.verify), books (ledger.check holds) and tested (the newest backup read back whole, backup.verify) each exactly 1, and room (bytes this user may still write minus the floor kept free) 1..999999999999999999; anything else is not safe; a flag of 2 or a room past 18 digits is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads above 0 as yes)
the same rule as safe_start as a number to count with: 1 safe, 0 not; a flag that is not 0 or 1, or a room past 18 digits either way, is refused (Forth refuses, KRON answers: held)

the next repair step from the four check results of safe_start, the first that applies: 1 free space (room below 1), 2 test a backup (tested 0), 3 restore the books from the tested backup (books 0), 4 keep the broken journal and tell the owner (journal 0), 0 none, start normally; 0 exactly when safe_start holds; a flag that is not 0 or 1, or a room past 18 digits either way, is refused (BASIC refuses, KRON answers: held); advice only, each step waits for the owner

whether bytes to be written fit with a floor kept free: need + reserve <= free, need, free and reserve each 0..999999999999999999 and need + reserve too (Sutra's 9(18)); a negative count or a sum past 18 digits is held (Sutra refuses, KRON compares)

one byte of a published CID's text ("b" + base32 lower case of a CIDv1 raw sha2-256, 59 bytes, zxvd's ZXS_CID_LEN): 1 when the text is 59 bytes long and the byte code at pos is 'b' (98) at pos 0, else 'a'..'z' (97..122) or '2'..'7' (50..55); 0 when it is not; a whole text fits when every byte gives 1; outside len 1..255, pos 0..len-1, code 0..255 it is refused (Rust traps, KRON answers 0: held)

whether a block put into this node's blockstore is within its size: 0..1048576 bytes (1 MiB, zxvd's AIPI_MODULE_MAX for a put by path; a put by hex is held to 8000 bytes by zxvd); a count negative or past 9999999 is held (Sutra's 9(7) refuses, Eve answers no)

whether a block may be asked of this node's blockstore: 0..65536 bytes (zxvd's ZXVD_AIPI_GET_MAX; a larger block is refused there, never cut); a count negative or past 9999999 is held (Sutra's 9(7) refuses, Eve answers no)
a pin fits ^ZXSEED: pin (its place in the table) at most 2 places, bytes 7, sealed 1, stamp (seconds since 1970) 11, sign aside

how many lines of one leading fit on a page between its top and bottom margins: floor((height - top - bottom) / leading), every length in twips (1440 to the inch); height, top and bottom 0..31680 (22 inches), leading 1..31680 and top + bottom at most height, anything else refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)
how many pages a count of lines takes at a number of lines a page: ceil(lines / perpage), 0 for no lines; lines 0..999999999 and perpage 1..9999, anything else refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

one line of an invoice or report table: a quantity in thousandths of a unit at a unit price in integer minor units, (qty * price + 500) / 1000, rounded half up to a whole minor unit; qty and price each 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(9)), else held (Sutra refuses, C++ answers to 64 bits); a negative or a product past 64 bits refused by both; a table's total is holdings_total

a page's setup inside its limits, each value against its own range, in twips: width and height 2880..31680 (2 to 22 inches), each margin (left, right, top, bottom) 0..4320 (3 inches), leading 160..1440 (8 to 72 points); whether the margins leave room for a line is lines_per_page
an entry of a document's outline fits ^ZXFOLIO: the document's number at most 9 digits, the entry's 4, its heading level 1, the page it starts on 6 and its line 9, sign aside

whether where the machine is may be shared with one contact: the person started it (started), the owner opted in to sharing (optin), the contact is on the list (listed) and zxvd's place.ask answered allowed (placeok), each a flag of exactly 1; a flag that is no flag (not 0 or 1) is never read as yes (Eve refuses it, KRON reads above 0 as yes: held)

seconds of a cancel window still to run before an action: window - waited while waited < window, else 0, both in seconds; window 0..99 and waited 0..999999999 (Sutra's 9(2) and 9(9)), anything else refused (Sutra refuses, KRON answers: held)

the minute of the day (0..1439) in a time zone: (utc + offset) wrapped into the day, utc the minute of the day in UTC (0..1439) and offset the zone's offset from UTC in minutes (-720..840, UTC-12:00 to UTC+14:00), one day added or taken away; anything outside the domain refused (Trebago refuses, KRON wraps any sum: held)

minutes from minute now (0..1439) of day today (1 Monday..7 Sunday, ISO 8601, as solstice.weekday) to the first ring at or after now of an alarm at minute at (0..1439) on the days of mask (1..127, bit 0 Monday..bit 6 Sunday): 0 when it rings this minute, at most 10079 (its only day today and its minute just gone); anything outside the domain, a mask of 0 among them, refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the standard offset from UTC in minutes of world-time zone index zone (0..37), the 38 offsets in use from UTC-12:00 to UTC+14:00 in ascending order (-720, -660, -600, -570, -540, -480, -420, -360, -300, -240, -210, -180, -120, -60, 0, 60, 120, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330, 345, 360, 390, 420, 480, 525, 540, 570, 600, 630, 660, 720, 765, 780, 840; index 14 is UTC); daylight saving is not applied; an index outside 0..37 refused

whether a clock setting is inside the limits: alarms 0..64 (how many there would be), snooze 1..60 minutes and a timer of 0..5999 minutes, never below zero, each against its own range; a count below zero or past its digits (alarms and snooze 2, timer 4) is held (Sutra refuses, Eve answers no)

why a clock setting is past the limits of clock_limits, the first that applies: 1 more than 64 alarms, 2 a snooze outside 1..60 minutes, 3 a timer past 5999 minutes, 0 none; a count below zero is no measurement (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

the order of two versions major.minor.patch, each part 0..999 (zxvd's update manifest, zx_upcheck.h): 1 when a is newer than b, 0 the same, -1 older, compared part by part from the major; a part outside 0..999 is no version and is refused (Sutra refuses, KRON answers: held)

both signatures of a release checked and verified: each of the two verify results is exactly 1; 0 (failed) or any other value (no result) is not dual-signed (Eve: no fit; KRON reads above 0 as verified, so a result of 2 is held)
an update's record fits ^ZXTIDE: seq at most 9 digits, major, minor and patch 3 each, signed 1, outcome 1, stamp (ms since 1970) 15, sign aside

whether a consent the owner granted covers an action, each part given as its margin: scopegap (the scopes the action needs, personal data 1 and money 2, that the grant does not hold) exactly 0, ceilingleft (the grant's ceiling minus the action's amount, in minor units) 0..999999999999999999 and secondsleft (the grant's expiry minus now) 1..86400, the longest zxvd's web4.consent grants; a margin past its range is held (Eve answers no, Sutra refuses past s9(1), s9(18), s9(5)); advice only, a grant is the owner's act

a Web4 feed envelope fits ^ZXRAMBLE: id (1..4294967295 in the feed) at most 10 digits, kind 1 (0 request, 1 response, 2 stream, 3 consent), status 1 (0 signed, 1 held, 2 denied), amount (minor units) 18, stamp (seconds since 1970) 12, sign aside

two exact rationals added: an / ad + bn / bd, reduced, its denominator above 0, never rounded; each part -999999999999999999..999999999999999999 (18 digits, the ledger's s9(18)), a part past that held (Trebago refuses, KRON answers); a denominator of 0 or a result past int64 / int64 refused by both (kernel/src/rational)
one exact rational less another: an / ad - bn / bd, reduced, its denominator above 0, never rounded; the parts and refusals of rational_sum
two exact rationals multiplied: (an / ad) * (bn / bd), reduced, its denominator above 0, never rounded; the parts and refusals of rational_sum
one exact rational divided by another: (an / ad) / (bn / bd), reduced, its denominator above 0, never rounded; a b of 0 refused by both; the parts and other refusals of rational_sum

an amount in integer minor units of one currency at an exchange rate rnum / rden (minor units of the other for one of this one): floor(amount * rnum / rden) whole minor units of the other; amount 0..999999999999 (Sutra's 9(12)), rnum and rden 1..999999 (9(6)), past them held (Sutra and ALGOL 60 refuse, KRON answers), a rate part of 0 refused by all; shown, never posted

what currency_at_rate leaves over: amount * rnum - floor(amount * rnum / rden) * rden, in rden-ths of a minor unit of the other currency (0..rden - 1), so the conversion is exact with it; the domain of currency_at_rate, past it held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

a quantity from one unit to another by exact factors, qty * factor(src) / factor(dst) reduced, the factors num / den of the base unit by unit index (tally_rules.h TL2: 0 mm, 1 cm, 2 m, 3 km, 4 in 127/5000, 5 ft, 6 yd, 7 mi; 8 mg, 9 g, 10 kg, 11 oz, 12 lb 45359237/100000; 13 ml, 14 l, 15 US fl oz, 16 US gal 473176473/125000; 17 s, 18 min, 19 h, 20 day); refused when an index is no unit or the two are of different dimensions

a temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius as tenths of a degree Fahrenheit: celsius * 9 / 5 + 320, an exact reduced rational, never rounded (1 is 1609/5); celsius -1000..1000 (-100 to 100 degrees), anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

rain (any length) in tenths of a millimetre as hundredths of an inch: rain * 50 / 127 (25.4 mm to the inch), an exact reduced rational, never rounded (127 is 50); rain 0..99999, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

a speed in tenths of a metre a second as tenths of a kilometre an hour: wind * 18 / 5 (3.6 km/h to 1 m/s), an exact reduced rational, never rounded (1 is 18/5); wind 0..2000, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

the advisory warnings a reading raises, as flags to add: 1 frost (temp at or below 0, tenths of a degree Celsius), 2 heat (temp at or above 350), 4 gale (wind at or above 172 tenths of a m/s); temp -1000..1000 and wind 0..2000, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held); advisory only, official warnings take precedence

a reading that raises no advisory warning, the same rule as weather_warning_flags as a truth: temp 1..349 tenths of a degree Celsius and wind 0..171 tenths of a m/s, each held to its own range (Eve declares them, KRON compares; a negative wind is held)

the lowest, the highest and the mean floored toward minus infinity of a vector of temperatures in tenths of a degree Celsius, three answers in that order; every value -1000..1000 and at least one, else refused

the exact sum of the cells of a range of one column or row, one cell per row: a cell adds its value when its position (its row in a column, its column in a row) lies inside its range lo..hi, both ends inside; added from the first, refused when a partial sum passes 64 bits, never wrapped (Trebago from the first, KRON from the last: past 64 bits one way only is held)

an amount of money from whole units and hundredths in integer minor units at a fixed scale of 100: units * 100 + cents, the sign carried by both (-12.34 is units -12, cents -34); units -9999999999999999..9999999999999999 (Sutra's s9(16)) and cents -99..99 (s9(2)), else held (Sutra refuses, KRON answers)

whether a formula's evaluation is inside its limits, each against its own range: depth (formulas deep) 0..16 and refs (cells referenced in all) 0..65536; past either, a cycle or a runaway fan, it is refused
a spreadsheet cell's sparse record fits ^ZXFURROW: sheet at most 4 digits, row 7, column 5, kind 1 (1 number, 2 money, 3 formula) and value 18, sign aside

one cross-reference offset of a document is well formed: its header present (header 1), the offset 0..268435455 and room (the file's size less the offset) 1..268435456, so it names a byte inside a file no larger than zxvd's largest (256 MiB); a document is well formed when it has one or more offsets and every one is; a header that is no flag, or an offset past 256 MiB, is held (Eve refuses, KRON answers)

why one cross-reference offset is not well formed, the first that applies: 1 no header (header 0), 2 the offset outside the file (below 0, or room below 1), 0 none; a header that is neither 0 nor 1, an offset past 268435455 or a room past 268435456 is no measurement, refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

the zoom that shows a whole page in a view, in hundredths of a percent (10000 the page at its own size): min(floor(10000 * vieww / pagew), floor(10000 * viewh / pageh)), page sides 1..99999 and view sides 0..99999 pixels (Sutra's 9(5)); a side outside refused (Sutra refuses, KRON answers: held)

an annotation of a document fits ^ZXBROAD: note 1..9999, page 1..999999, x and y 0..99999 points from the page's lower left corner, kind 1 highlight, 2 note or 3 underline, stamp 0..999999999999999 ms since 1970; a value MYRA's digits hold but Eve's ranges do not (kind 4, note 0, a negative place) is held

what one of the nine forms of capital (zcap_forms.h: 0 financial .. 8 system) shows as held, in minor units: minor (the form's holder balances summed, coffer.holdings) for a priceable form (0..3, 8), 0 for a state-reserved form (4..7), which is never priced; form outside 0..8, minor negative or past 18 digits refused (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers: held)

one form of capital's share of the priced whole in hundredths of a percent, never rounded up: floor(10000 * held / whole) for a priceable form, 0 for a state-reserved form (4..7); whole 1..99999999999999 (14 digits) and held 0..whole, form 0..8, anything else refused (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers: held)

whether a form of capital is state-reserved (finance/capital_forms.h capital_is_state_reserved): social 4, natural 5, cultural 6, spiritual 7, inalienable, never priced and never a derivative underlying; a value outside the nine forms 0..8 is no form (Eve answers FALSE, Sutra refuses: held)
the same rule as capital_state_reserved as a number to count with: 1 for forms 4..7, 0 for 0..3 and 8; anything outside 0..8 refused (Sutra refuses, Trebago answers 0: held)

whether a path to this machine is reachable: the switch that exposes it is on (sw = 1) and the asker is no farther than the network mode lets in and no farther than the listener binds, given as two rooms each 0..2 (moderoom = mode - far, bindroom = bind - far; mode 0 off 1 lan 2 online, bind 0 this machine 1 private network 2 every interface, far 0 this machine 1 local network 2 beyond); a switch that is no flag or a room off the ladder is never open (Eve refuses it, KRON reads a switch above 0 as on and a room above -1 as room: held)
the same rule as path_reachable as a number to count with: 1 open, else 0; a switch not 0 or 1 or a room outside -2..2 is refused (C++ traps, KRON answers: held)

the scope of an IPv4 (fam 4, a.b.c.d) or IPv6 (fam 6: a b its first two octets, c d its last two) address: 0 public, 1 loopback 127/8 ::1, 2 private 10/8 172.16/12 192.168/16, 3 link-local 169.254/16 fe80::/10, 4 unique-local fc00::/7, 5 no peer address (0/8, 224/3, ff00::/8, ::/16 other than ::1, the caller giving c = d = 255 when ::/16 has a nonzero octet between); another family or an octet outside 0..255 is refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

one opening or closing of a path filed as a ^ZXHEDGEROW record: seq 1..999999999, path 1..6, open 0 or 1, port 0..65535, stamp 0..99999999999 seconds; MYRA holds each field's digits, Eve its meaning (a path of 7 or a port of 65536 is held)

whether a component built for version k = kmajor.kminor.kpatch fits a running version d = dmajor.dminor.dpatch (a kit against libzxv's ABI, sdk/docs/STABILITY.md): 1 when the majors are the same and d's minor and patch are at least k's, else 0; each part 0..999, one outside is no version (Sutra's 9(3) refuses, KRON answers: held)

whether a release may be offered to the owner for install (advice, the owner confirms): both verify results exactly 1, it fits (version_compatible exactly 1) and room, the bytes the owner may still write less the bytes it needs, 0..999999999999999999; Eve holds each field to its own range, KRON reads anything above 0 as yes, so a result of 2 is held

a fabrication recipe's download size in bytes: the exact sum of its blocks, each 1..2097152 (FAB_BLOCK_MAX), 1..4096 of them (FAB_MAX_BLOCKS); any block outside its range refuses the sum, never rounded
the bytes a kit or app puts on disk: the exact sum of its files, each 0..999999999999, 1..4096 of them; any file outside its range refuses the sum
a kit's record fits ^ZXTOOLCHEST: kit (its place in the catalogue) at most 3 places, lang 2, major, minor and patch 3 each, bytes (installed size) 15, sign aside

one assignment keeps a four-valued consequence (designated values TRUE and BOTH): premise is the value code of the premises' conjunction (lpres_conjoin; TRUE when there are none) and conclusion the conclusion's, in the kernel's numbering NEITHER 0, TRUE 1, FALSE 2, BOTH 3; TRUE when the premise is not designated (0 or 2) or the conclusion is (1 or 3); a conclusion follows when no assignment answers FALSE (count them with witness.kind_count); a code outside 0..3 refused (Sutra refuses, KRON answers: held)

a four-valued formula inside the workbench's limits, each against its own range: vars (distinct variables) 0..6, so its table has at most 4^6 = 4096 assignments, and depth (connectives deep, an atom 0) 0..16; Eve and KRON agree on every integer

a harmonic line frame's tag octet from its parts (zt_harmonic_wire.h W3): 100 * sync + 10 * shell + trunk, sync 0..1, shell 0..9, trunk 0..9, so it splits back as trunk = tag mod 10, shell = (tag / 10) mod 10, sync = tag / 100; a part outside its range is refused (Forth refuses, KRON answers: held), and no part makes a reserved tag (200..255)

whether a message fits an Endian Hopping band (a message class of the sealed, private path, not a radio frequency band): 0..2048 bytes (EHOP_MAX_PAYLOAD), the band's largest frame on the wire 49..2096 bytes, and bytes + 48 (header, channel tag and AEAD tag) at most that frame; a message too long for its band within both ranges is held (Eve holds the ranges, KRON the relation)

whether a message may go out on its bearer under the amateur-radio rule (docs/P2P_PROTOCOL_TWINS.md P13, 47 CFR 97.113 and 97.309): a private bearer (amateur 0) either way, an amateur bearer (amateur 1) only in the clear (sealed 0); amateur 1 with sealed 1 is refused, and a flag that is neither 0 nor 1 fails closed (Sutra refuses one below 0 or past 9, KRON answers no: held)

whether a radio message fits its log record ^ZXAERIE: seq at most 9 digits, bearer 1 (0 private, 1 amateur), band 1, direction 1, sender 10, bytes 4 and stamp (ms since 1970) 13, sign aside; no piece holds an amount

whether a letter (one Web4 envelope, web4.post) may be sent: verified (web4.card_verify's answer for the recipient's card) exactly 1, room (2048, web4.post's payload, minus the payload's bytes) 0..2048 and consentgap (the scopes it needs, personal data and money, that the owner has not consented to) exactly 0; a card answer of 2 is held (Eve answers no, KRON reads above 0 as verified)
a letter's size limits, each field against its own range: subject 0..200 bytes and body 0..1837 bytes, so that "Subject: " + subject + two newlines + body never passes web4.post's 2048-byte payload

why a mail address local@domain does not fit, the first that applies, from counts of its bytes (size, ats, local before the first '@', domain after the last '@', the longest and shortest label of the domain, bad bytes): 1 shorter than 3 bytes or past 254, 2 not exactly one '@', 3 local part empty or past 64, 4 domain empty or past 253, 5 a label empty or past 63, 6 a byte not allowed, 0 none; counts no one address can give (negative, more parts than bytes, shortest past longest, longest past the domain) are refused (Rust traps, KRON answers: held)

a letter filed by folder and thread fits ^ZXROOKERY: folder (0 inbox, 1 drafts, 2 sent, 3 held, 4 trash) 1 digit, thread (the feed id that began it) 10, letter (its feed id, or its place in a folder) 10, size (bytes) 4, stamp (seconds since 1970) 12, sign aside

whether a device of the owner's mesh may be revoked from this one: an admin session (sessionadmin = 1), not this device (isself = 0), still active (isactive = 1), and 1..8 active admins left once it is gone (adminsleft, the active admins less the device when it is one; 8 is devmesh's DM_MAX_DEVICES); anything else is no (Eve declares each range, KRON reads past the flags: a 2, a -1 or 9 admins is held); advice only, the owner confirms a revocation twice

whole minutes, rounded up, an invitation issued at `issued` with a life of `ttl` still has at `now` (ms): ceil(max(0, issued + ttl - now) / 60000), 0 lapsed; issued and now 0..253402300799999, ttl 0..600000 (devmesh's ten minutes), else refused

how many peers of a vector of states are in the state want (given on every row): 1 active, 2 revoked, 3 waiting, exact; a state or want outside 1..3 refuses the count (Trebago refuses, KRON counts: held)
a mesh device's record fits ^ZXTRELLIS: peer, state, role, admin and held 1 digit each, since (the roster version) at most 18 digits, sign aside

one contestant's exact score total: the sum of the scores of the graded answers whose model equals want (one value for the whole vector), added from the first, 0 when none is want's; each score 0..100 points, and any score outside refuses the whole total (Trebago refuses, KRON adds it: held)

the fastest run so far, one fold step: min(fastest, ms), each 0..3600000 milliseconds (an hour, the longest run Retort allows); a value outside is no latency, refused (the wasm module traps, KRON answers: held); start the fold at 3600000
the slowest run so far, one fold step: max(slowest, ms), each 0..3600000 milliseconds; a value outside is no latency, refused (the wasm module traps, KRON answers: held); start the fold at 0

the limits on one AI or sandbox run fit: prompt 1..4095 bytes (swarm.ask's maxLength), fuel 1..999999999999999999 (aipi.execute needs a fuel_max above 0; 18 digits) and seconds 1..3600 (zxvd sets no wall-clock limit; an hour is the default taken); each field held to its own range

the exact energy one answer took: uj / answers as a reduced fraction of microjoules, never rounded; uj 0..999999999999999999 (power.status total_uj, 18 digits) and answers 1..999999999, anything else refused
a model run's record fits ^ZXRETORT: run (its place in the session) at most 3 places, model 2, kind 1, prompt bytes 4, fuel 18, ms 7, score 3 (-1 while ungraded) and uj 18, sign aside

column1: # Local words: a name each app may define for itself, because it means
# something different in each (an app's own total, count or rule). A
# local word never stands for a shared concept; when two apps need the
# same meaning, register it above and give it one owner.

column4: whether the owner may post in a room: member (the owner holds a role that speaks there), joined (the room is joined) and enabled (its feature switch is on), each a flag exactly 1; anything else, 2 among it, is no (Eve holds each flag to 1..1, KRON reads any flag above 0 as yes: held)
whether a message's length in bytes of UTF-8 is inside zxvd's limit for a post: 1..1024 (chat.post, social.post, pspace.post); 0, a negative or 1025 and past is no
whether a reaction's length in bytes of UTF-8 (an emoji or a word) is inside zxvd's limit: 1..32 (chat.react, social.react); 0, a negative or 33 and past is no

a room's unread posts: newest (the posts known in the room) minus seen (the posts the owner has read), never below 0, one room per row; a count below 0 or past 12 digits (999999999999) is refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)
a room fits its ^ZXCOMMONS index record: room number 3 digits, kind 1 (0 this node, 1 a group, 2 a space across nodes), newest and seen 12, members 6, each sign aside
a message fits its ^ZXCOMMONSMSG index record: room 3 digits, pos (its place in the room) 12, Lamport time 18, stamp (ms since 1970) 13, bytes 4, each sign aside

whether the camera may take a frame: a sensor present (sensor), the mode asked for supported (mode) and the frame fitting the capture buffer (buffer), each a flag exactly 1; a flag that is no flag (not 0 or 1) is never read as yes (Eve refuses it, KRON reads it above 0 as yes: held)
the same rule as camera_ready as a number to count with: 1 when sensor, mode and buffer are each 1, else 0; a flag that is not 0 or 1 is refused (Forth refuses, KRON answers: held)

an exposure inside its limits, each value against its own range with nothing relating them: iso 25..25600, shutter (how long the exposure lasts) 31..30000000 microseconds (1/32000 s to 30 s) and comp (exposure compensation) -9..9 thirds of a stop

a photo fits its ^ZXPINHOLE index record: photo (its number) at most 9 digits, album 4, bytes 12, width and height 5 each (pixels), placed 1 (1 a place tag added with the owner's permit) and stamp (ms since 1970) 15, each sign aside

the first day on or after day (days since 1970-01-01, a Thursday; 0 .. 2932896, 9999-12-31) whose weekday is not in skip, a mask with bit 0 Monday .. bit 6 Sunday, 0 .. 126; at most 6 days later; refused when skip skips every day or the answer passes 9999-12-31
a task is overdue: still open (open 1) and at least one day late, given as the margin late = today - due in days, 1 .. 2932896 (9999-12-31); a margin past that is no measurement, not overdue
a task fits its ^ZXTASK record: task (its number) at most 9 digits, list 3, start 7 and due 7 (days since 1970), every 4, unit 1 (1 days, 7 weeks), skip 3 (a weekday mask) and done 1, each sign aside

a contact's fields inside their limits, each length against its own range with nothing relating them: the name 1..128 bytes of UTF-8 (namelen), the phone number 0..15 digits (E.164's most), the mail address 0..254 bytes (RFC 5321's path limit) and the note 0..1024 bytes

whether a name begins with a typed prefix, over name codes (a name's first 9 letters two decimal digits each, left-aligned, 00 past the end: a..z and A..Z 01..26, 0..9 27..36, a character past ASCII 37, other bytes passed over): 1 when prefix <= name < prefix + 100^(9 - len), len the prefix's count of codes 0..9, else 0; len outside 0..9 or a code outside 0..999999999999999999 refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

each contact's likely duplicates, one contact per row: how many other contacts share its card code (both 1 or more and equal) or its name code (name_prefix_match's code, both 1 or more and equal), counted once each, exact; 0 is no code and matches nothing; a card code outside 0..999999999999999 or a name code outside 0..999999999999999999 refused (Trebago refuses, KRON counts it: held); advisory, never merged without the owner

a contact fits its ^ZXKINDRED record: contact (its number) at most 6 digits, card and node codes 15 each (an agent_id's or NodeID's first 12 hex digits plus 1, 0 none), name code 18, verified 1 and stamp (ms since 1970) 13, sign aside
an entry of a name index fits ^ZXKINDREDNAME, the global a name-prefix search walks in order: name code at most 18 digits, contact 6 and stamp (ms since 1970) 13, sign aside

the exact mean of a vector of latencies in milliseconds: their sum over their count as a reduced fraction, never rounded; every latency 0..3600000 (Retort's latency range) and at least one, else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)

one contact of net.peers' routing table fits its ^ZXLODESTONE record: contact (its place in the list) at most 3 digits, bucket 3, ubh 1, seen (ms since 1970) 15, book 1, member 1, pending (receipts outstanding) 9, sign aside

a vertex's screen x from the screen's centre: x, z turned about the vertical axis by cos, sin in 4096ths (xr = x * cos + z * sin, zr = z * cos - x * sin), scaled by scale percent and seen in perspective from focal units in front of the screen plane: floor(scale * focal * xr / (100 * (4096 * focal + zr))), the floor toward minus infinity; x, z -100000..100000, cos and sin -4096..4096, scale 1..1000, focal 1..1000000 and 4096 * focal + zr at least 1 (in front of the viewer), anything else refused (C++ refuses, KRON answers: held)

a vertex's screen y from the screen's centre, up: the same turn and view as vertex_screen_x, which keeps the height y: floor(scale * focal * 4096 * y / (100 * (4096 * focal + zr))), zr = z * cos - x * sin, the floor toward minus infinity; y in -100000..100000 and the rest as vertex_screen_x, anything else refused (C++ refuses, KRON answers: held)

the depth effect: how far a layer at depth (0 the nearest .. far the farthest) moves when the nearest layer moves shift pixels, the farthest still: floor(shift * (far - depth) / far), the floor toward minus infinity; shift -100000..100000, far 1..1000000, depth 0..far; a far of 0 refused

the volume a closed triangle mesh encloses, by signed tetrahedra: the corners one to a row and three to a face (x, y, z; counter-clockwise seen from outside) and orient one to a face (1 as wound, -1 reversed, 0 left out); the sum of orient * det(a, b, c) / 6 over the faces, an exact reduced rational, never rounded (cubic units of the coordinates); a coordinate outside -100000..100000, an orient outside -1..1 or corners not three to a face refuses the whole sum; at most 1020 faces (a mesh's limit)
a mesh inside its limits, each against its own range: vertices 4..512 and faces 4..1020 (a tetrahedron is the least closed mesh; a closed mesh of V vertices has 2V - 4 faces)
a mesh fits its ^ZXRELIEF index record: mesh (its number) at most 9 digits, vertices 3, faces 4 and mtime (Unix seconds) 12, each sign aside

the share of a subject's test results that passed, in hundredths of a percent, never rounded up: floor(10000 * passes / runs); runs 1..999999999 and passes 0..runs, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON divides as it is: held)

whether a tested subject meets the owner's bar, each part given as its margin: pass share minus the bar 0..10000, most refusals allowed minus refusals and runs minus the fewest runs each 0..999999999; a margin below 0 misses, one past its range is held (Eve refuses, KRON reads any margin at or above 0 as met)
each score's place among a score vector, best first, ties sharing the higher place: 1 + the number of scores strictly greater (competition ranking, 1224)

how many freights (zxvd's freight.pack: 20 bytes a data row, k data rows a freight) a payload of size bytes takes: ceil(size / (20 * k)), 0 for 0 bytes; size 0..999999999999 and k 1..168, anything else refused (Trebago refuses, KRON answers: held)
